execution_user_authorization.interpretation: The user approved terms/data/P0 execution intent. This lane remained limited to synthetic scorer fixture work; the receipt records that exact frozen contract/review remain before launch, and no actual scoring, data access, or launch occurred here.

api.function: score_prediction_csv(prediction_csv: bytes, expected_ids: tuple[str, ...], reference_sale_prices: Mapping[str, int | float | Decimal], limits: ScorerLimits) -> ScoreResult
api.artifact_failure: ArtifactInvalidError with an INVALID message and no score
api.contract_failure: ScorerContractError with a SCORER_ERROR message and no score
api.numeric_policy: ASCII decimal CSV lexemes are converted to Fraction through Decimal. Finite int/float/Decimal references are converted the same way; float uses str(float). MAE is exact Fraction total absolute error divided by row count, with no rounding, clipping, log transform, ranking, or per-row residual output.
api.identity_policy: Requires parsed header exactly [Id, SalePrice], every data row exactly two fields, and every Id equal to the same-position caller-supplied tuple entry. Before any reference set/dict conversion, the tuple must be nonempty, strings-only, unique, no longer than max_data_rows, and each UTF-8 ID at most max_field_bytes; no ID coercion or trimming occurs.

limits.production_values: Not selected or implied by this fixture.

exact_semantics.max_artifact_bytes: Whole submitted byte sequence, checked before decode.
exact_semantics.max_data_rows: Maximum public manifest IDs and maximum data records; header excluded.
exact_semantics.max_field_bytes: Maximum raw CSV field token bytes, including quote/escape bytes and headers. Public IDs and reference keys are limited by UTF-8 encoded byte length.
exact_semantics.parser_state: A byte-level preflight enforces raw field and record bounds before UTF-8 decode and strict csv.reader parsing. The module does not call csv.field_size_limit and changes no process-global CSV parser limit.

tests.data: Only tiny generated in-memory synthetic CSV bytes and synthetic references; no source task data, download, training, evaluation, network, provider, ORX, credential, native import, or artifact-lock integration.

public manifest max-row and UTF-8 field capacity before reference conversion
multibyte and surrogate public IDs/reference keys with sanitized scorer errors
no csv.field_size_limit mutation during a valid score
